policy.admission: preserve source/runtime and undefined/infeasible construction refusals; report full and matched denominators; never repair/crop to gain entry
policy.audit: all callbacks/native mobile gradients, focal and global H geometry, input heavy-shape findings, radii/slots/nonownership and all adverse contexts; no result-based arm selection
policy.combination: disjoint CH2/CH3 H ownership; apply both fixed constructors without energy/phase search, revisits, H regeneration or force/mass/parameter edits
policy.construction: reuse frozen graph CH3 phase-zero second-shell frame and heavy-compatible CH2 signed heavy-plane formula; each original C-H radius and all nonowned coordinates retained
policy.controls: unchanged nm endpoints must reproduce each original native H endpoint; known positive/intersection replays are computational controls, NOT independent new samples
policy.enrollment: ALL24 original 1SHG reconstruction-stress starts plus ALL16 fixed eight-input source/seed capture entries; no replacement, source cleanup or new seed
policy.limits: H-stage only; no whole-system acceptance, native accuracy, public candidate/PDB, new chemistry/platform qualification or production capability
policy.ownership: actual native bond graph, full case-sensitive identities and pre-H/newly mobile H ownership; no measured/kept H rewrite or guessed label aliases
policy.scope: 24 stress conditions on ONE 1SHG structure plus five admitted prepared protein views/two seeds; inherited three source refusals/two seeds remain
policy.stress: intentionally poor generated-heavy source conditions remain explicit stress strata, not newly admitted healthy structures or a claim H initialization repairs heavy geometry
policy.timing: existing-input qualification fixed before factorial adapter/initializers are evaluated; previously studied cases, not blinded proteins or temporal holdout
